load_images: load the CelebA dataset images and attributes split into train, valid, and test sets
normalize_images: normalize image tensor values from 0-255 range to -1 to 1 range
log_attributes_stats: log the distribution statistics of face attributes across train, valid, and test sets
DataSampler_train_batch: get a random batch of normalized images with attributes and optional flip augmentation
DataSampler_eval_batch: get a contiguous range of normalized images with attributes for evaluation
